description:
A long conversation re-lexes every prior assistant message every frame. Cache rendered output so finalized messages cost effectively zero to re-render.

## Shape

Per-message cache keyed on `(message_id, content_hash, width) → [iolist]`:

- On render, if the key matches the cached entry, reuse the lines.
- Width changes invalidate.
- Entry is populated the first time a message is rendered (or when the streaming message finalizes).

## Acceptance

- `transcript.render` duration is flat in `msg_count` for finalized messages (verify against telemetry).
- Memory is bounded by transcript size; no per-frame allocation churn for unchanged messages.
- Theme/syntax-highlight changes invalidate cleanly (likely via cache reset, not key — keep the mechanism simple).

## Notes

- The cache stores both line bytes and line count. Off-screen messages still need line count for layout; the cache supplies it without traversing line bytes.
- Keep cache scope per render owner, not global, to avoid lifetime hazards.
title: Cache rendered lines per finalized message
